title: Gradient Extrapolation for Debiased Representation Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Worst-Group Accuracy (WGA) and Group-Balanced Accuracy (GBA) on datasets where gender is a spurious attribute correlated with target labels, such as age (bFFHQ), hair color (CelebA), and toxicity (CivilComments).
Evaluating Worst-Group Accuracy (WGA) on a toxic comment classification task (CivilComments) across samples mentioning specific racial identities like Black and White.
Evaluating Worst-Group Accuracy (WGA) on a toxic comment classification task (CivilComments) across samples mentioning Christian, Muslim, and other religious identities.
Evaluating Worst-Group Accuracy (WGA) on a toxic comment classification task (CivilComments) across samples mentioning LGBTQ identities.

Evaluating Group-Balanced Accuracy (GBA) and Worst-Group Accuracy (WGA) on vision datasets to measure the model's reliance on non-causal visual artifacts, such as image backgrounds (Waterbirds), colors (C-MNIST), and textures (C-CIFAR-10).
